data.name: DonationsText
data.value: Donations are completely optional. I will never charge any fees for using MAIRA. That said, donations make me feel warm and fuzzy, and is a great motivator for me to keep working on MAIRA. A huge thank you to everybody who have donated already!

data.name: CodeContributionsText
data.value: Are you a C# developer? This project is open to contributions. Learn more by visiting the GitHub repository.

data.name: TranslationContributionsText
data.value: A heartfelt thank you to everyone listed here who volunteered their time and talent to translate MarvinsAIRA into so many languages. Your work helped make this app accessible to sim racers all over the world. Translations are now handled automatically by machine, so no further translation help is needed — but these contributors will always have my deepest gratitude.

data.name: DocumentationText
data.value: This documentation website is a forever work in progress, because new features are being added to this app all the time. I do update the documentation as often as I can, but if the information you are looking for isn't there yet, you can try looking in the Discord server, or in the iRacing forums, for the answers to your questions.

data.name: DiscordText
data.value: The MAIRA Discord server is the fastest way to get answers to your questions, if you can't find it in the documentation. There are volunteers helping out, and I also try to help out as well.

data.name: ForumsText
data.value: This is where it all started. You can look for answers in here, but I am not as active here as I used to be. Visiting the Discord server is the best way to ask questions.

data.name: Wizard_Step0_Line1
data.value: I'm Marvin the Wizard, and I'm here to help you tame the mighty MAIRA!

data.name: Wizard_Step0_Line2
data.value: With a wave of my checkered flag, I'll guide you through the most important settings so you can get on track as fast as possible. 🏁✨

data.name: Wizard_Step0_Line3
data.value: Shall we begin, or are you an experienced wizard yourself and prefer to configure everything manually?

data.name: Wizard_Step1_Line1
data.value: Choose whether you prefer a light or dark theme. Toggle the switch below to preview the change live.

data.name: Wizard_Step2_Line1
data.value: Select your force-feedback steering wheel from the list below.

data.name: Wizard_Step2_Hint1
data.value: Don't see your wheel? Make sure it is powered on and connected, then the list will refresh automatically.

data.name: Wizard_Step2_Hint2
data.value: Fanatec users: Fanatec wheels typically appear as two separate devices in the list. If the one you selected doesn't work, try selecting the other one!

data.name: Wizard_Step3_Line1
data.value: Enter the maximum force your wheelbase is capable of producing, in Newton-meters (Nm). MAIRA uses this value to correctly scale all force feedback output for your hardware.

data.name: Wizard_Step3_Hint1
data.value: We've made our best guess based on your selected wheel — but feel free to adjust it if needed.

data.name: Wizard_Step3_Hint2
data.value: Important: If you have already limited your wheel's maximum torque output inside your wheel manufacturer's software (e.g., Fanatec Wheel Control Panel, Moza Pit House, etc.), enter that reduced value here instead of the hardware's physical maximum. MAIRA needs to know what your wheel will actually deliver, not what it's capable of in theory.

data.name: Wizard_Step4_Line1
data.value: MAIRA lets you bind physical buttons on your wheel or controller to raise and lower the Force Feedback Strength on the fly — without ever leaving the cockpit.

data.name: Wizard_Step4_Line2
data.value: Click the - and + buttons below to assign inputs to each one. This step is optional — you can skip it and set up bindings later from the Racing Wheel page.

data.name: Wizard_Step4_Hint1
data.value: Once an input is mapped, the button border will turn orange to confirm it.

data.name: Wizard_Step5_Line1
data.value: While you are driving on track, MAIRA continuously measures the actual peak torque your wheel produces. It uses that measurement to suggest the ideal Max Force value — one that uses your wheel's full range without ever clipping the signal.

data.name: Wizard_Step5_Line2
data.value: With the Auto-Set feature, you can bind a physical button on your wheel or controller to the Set action. Press it at any moment during a session and MAIRA will instantly update Max Force to match your measured peak — no menus, no interruptions.

data.name: Wizard_Step5_Line3
data.value: A companion Clear button resets the running measurement so you can start a fresh reading — useful if your car has gone off track or hit something.

data.name: Wizard_Step5_Question
data.value: Would you like to set up the Auto-Set feature?

data.name: Wizard_Step6_Line1
data.value: First, adjust the Auto Target headroom to taste, then map your Set and Clear buttons.

data.name: Wizard_Step6_Hint1
data.value: Auto Target sets where in your wheel's force range the measured peak should land. Lower the target to keep more headroom above the peak; raise it to use more of the wheel's range.

data.name: Wizard_Step7_Line1
data.value: How do you like your force feedback to feel? Move the slider below to tell MAIRA your preference and it will configure the algorithm, detail and smoothing settings to match.

data.name: Wizard_Step7_Line2
data.value: Don't worry — you can always fine-tune everything manually on the Racing Wheel page later.

data.name: Wizard_Step7_Preset_MaxSmooth_Desc
data.value: Heavy delta limiting at 250 Nm/s. Very calm, rounded feedback.

data.name: Wizard_Step7_Preset_Smooth_Desc
data.value: Delta limiting at 500 Nm/s. Softer edges and reduced sharpness.

data.name: Wizard_Step7_Preset_SlightlySmooth_Desc
data.value: Light delta limiting at 1000 Nm/s. Minor transient softening.

data.name: Wizard_Final_Line1
data.value: Thank you for trying MAIRA! The wizard is now complete.

data.name: Wizard_Final_Line2
data.value: You can re-run this wizard at any time by visiting the App Settings page and clicking the "Launch Wizard" button.

data.name: Wizard_Final_DocLinkSuffix
data.value: to open the documentation and learn about the common controls.
